content:
Apple TV currently has a strong lineup, with flagship shows including 《Slow Horses》、《Ted Lasso》、《Dark Matter》, and Ben Affleck's new comedy 《Brothers》. But there are even more shows on the way. Below is the full list of Apple TV premieres for October.

The Last First: Winter K2

  • Date: October 2
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Documentary

Directed by Amir Bar-Lev, 《The Last First: Winter K2》 tells a complex, thrilling, and moving story that examines the extreme mountaineering industry and its cultural evolution. The story focuses on a 2021 expedition, with mountaineers John Snorri Sigurjónsson (from Iceland) and the Pakistani father-and-son duo Ali and Sajid Sadpara, aiming to become the first team to summit K2 in winter (the harshest time on the mountain). During their perilous climb, they encounter social media-driven influencer climbers and their film crews, commercial expedition clients, and renowned Nepalese mountaineer Nims and his Sherpa team. 《The Last First: Winter K2》 takes viewers to the frozen heights of K2, facing unpredictable weather, revealing an unexpected and layered story—of strategy and determination, hierarchy and class, money and power—all unfolding in a life-or-death environment.

The Sisters Grimm (Season 2)

  • Date: October 2
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Kids & Family

Two orphaned sisters navigate a town full of fairy tale and fantasy characters, facing all manner of heroes and villains while investigating the mystery of their missing parents. Blending exploration, fantasy, and adventure, 《The Sisters Grimm》 delivers important lessons for viewers of all ages.

Small Prophets

  • Date: October 7
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Comedy

《Small Prophets》 is a comedy about the eccentric Michael Sleep (played by Pearce Quigley). Since his beloved Clea disappeared seven years ago, he's been living a quiet life—working at a hardware store, visiting his father Brian (played by Sir Michael Palin), and hoping for Clea's return. One day, Brian shares an ancient recipe made from rainwater, horse manure, and a touch of alchemy. Michael, somewhat skeptical, takes the recipe and begins trying to brew an artificial sprite—a magical creature that can predict the future—hoping to find the answer he wants most: "Will I ever see Clea again?"

Matchbox The Movie

  • Date: October 9
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Action

Adapted from the classic Mattel toy, 《Matchbox The Movie》 is an action-packed, globe-trotting adventure about a group of friends who have known each other since childhood. Their lives are upended when CIA agent Sean (played by John Cena)—their former leader who disappeared years ago—returns to their small town, accidentally pulling them into a thrilling, world-saving international chase.

Tenzing

  • Date: October 16
  • Type: Film
  • Category: Drama

Based on a true story, 《Tenzing》 tells the little-known story of Tenzing Norgay (played by Genden Phuntsok). A gifted Himalayan mountaineer, he and New Zealand climber Edmund Hillary (played by Tom Hiddleston) became the first people to summit Mount Everest. Encouraged by his wife Dawa (played by Thinley Lhamo) and supported by expedition secretary Jill Henderson (played by Caitríona Balfe), Tenzing successfully persuaded Colonel John Hunt (played by Willem Dafoe) to let him join the British expedition as a team member rather than just a porter. Western climbers saw "Everest" as a target to conquer, but Tenzing revered the sacred mountain "Chomolungma" as a divine mother goddess. During the climb, conflicts stemming from differences in background, class, and ambition proved just as intense as the mountain's dangers. But at the top of the world, empires, status, and ambition fell away, leaving only two outsiders bound by mutual respect and trust—for Tenzing, the realization of a lifelong dream and spiritual calling.

Where's Wanda? (Season 2)

  • Date: October 21
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Dark Comedy

Apple's first German-language series, 《Where's Wanda?》, is a dark comedy about parents Dodo and Carlotta Klatt desperately searching for their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda. Wanda disappeared without a trace months ago, and police have made no progress, so the family decides to take matters into their own hands. With help from their tech-savvy son Ole, they acquire surveillance equipment. Posing as utility company workers, they install listening devices throughout the community and half the neighborhood, only to discover that their neighbors are far from what they seem.

Nocturne

  • Date: October 30
  • Type: Series
  • Category: Crime Drama

The series follows Jonah Lynn (played by Liev Schreiber), a former military man turned homicide detective who is fed up with Philadelphia's blood-soaked streets and moves to a small town in western Pennsylvania hoping for a quieter life. But when the town and his family are threatened by cunning serial killer Jurek Walter (played by Graham), Jonah must protect everything he holds dear. When the full-scale search for Jurek's last missing victim reaches a stalemate, Jonah has to send his goddaughter—FBI agent Saga Bauer (played by Beetz)—to face Jurek head-on. How far is she willing to go?

New Episodes: 《Slow Horses》, 《Brothers》, and More

Apple TV also has new episodes dropping in October, including the following currently airing series:

  • 《Ted Lasso》: Jason Sudeikis's comedy continues with new episodes through October 7
  • 《Last Seen》: This crime thriller continues with new episodes through October 7
  • 《Slow Horses》: The acclaimed British spy drama continues with new episodes through October 21
  • 《Dark Matter》: Joel Edgerton's sci-fi series continues with new episodes through October 30
  • 《Brothers》: The comedy starring Ben Affleck and Woody Harrelson continues with new episodes through November 4

Which Apple TV October release are you planning to watch? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, and you can also subscribe via the Apple One bundle.
